name: dumbbell kneeling single arm shoulder press
description: A one-arm overhead press done on both knees. The kneeling position takes the legs out so your shoulder and core do the work.
instructions: Kneel on both knees with your hips tall and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder without leaning sideways.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.
